headline: Forget expensive sleepbuds. Buy this pillow instead
summary: Expensive sleepbuds offer discreet audio for side-sleepers. The article critiques these costly gadgets. It proposes a simpler, cheaper pillow alternative.

headline: After backlash, Meta pauses plan to ‘rate limit’ its smart glasses
summary: Meta planned a $20 monthly fee for smart glasses audio clarity. This feature operates locally, not cloud-based. The company paused the controversial subscription after public backlash.

headline: Meta just created a moderation nightmare for its smart glasses
summary: Meta's smart glasses are causing a major PR crisis. Public backlash centers on privacy erosion and surveillance fears. Users are exploiting the glasses to film unsuspecting individuals for "prank" content.

headline: Qualcomm is about to raise prices and that’s bad news for everyone
summary: Qualcomm notified customers of upcoming "double-digit" price increases. These hikes take effect for products shipped after September 1st. The company attributes the rise to higher supplier costs and ongoing component shortages.

headline: Spaceballs: The New One Creators on Making Mel Brooks' Yogurt CGI and Paying Tribute to John Candy | Comic Con 2026
summary: Rick Moranis and Josh Gad shared Spaceballs: The New One updates at SDCC. Mel Brooks' Yogurt character will be brought to life with CGI. The film promises fresh Star Wars gags and a tribute to John Candy.

headline: God of War Laufey Release Date Announced | Comic Con 2026
summary: God of War Laufey's official release date has been revealed. The highly anticipated title launches on February 16, 2027. This announcement came during Comic Con 2026.

headline: Next Kratos-Led God of War Game Is Coming After Laufey, and Connects Directly to Her Story | Comic Con 2026
summary: A new Kratos-led God of War game has been announced. It will directly follow the upcoming God of War Laufey title. The game's story will connect deeply with Laufey's narrative.

headline: American Caper From Absurd Ventures' Dan Houser Is Getting a Double-Sized Season Finale Issue #12 - Exclusive | Comic Con 2026
summary: Dan Houser's "American Caper" comic series is getting its season finale. Issue #12 will be double-sized for the conclusion. The finale is scheduled for release on November 11, 2026.

headline: How the mystery of dead animals dumped in villages led to a hidden world of illegal hunts
summary: Mysterious animal dumping in villages uncovered a hidden world of illegal hunts. Farmers report attacks linked to these activities. Police have received almost 9,000 reports of banned hare coursing.

headline: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
summary: Trump delivered criticism towards the press at the Correspondents' Dinner. The event itself was meant to celebrate press freedom. It followed the cancellation of the prior dinner due to a shooting.

headline: Police declare 'major incident' as wind change increases Cairngorms wildfire risk
summary: Police declared a "major incident" in the Cairngorms region. Shifting winds have significantly increased wildfire risks. Residents of Nethy Bridge village have been evacuated.

headline: Horror injury overshadows gymnastics silver for England at Commonwealths
summary: England secured a gymnastics team silver at the Commonwealth Games. A severe injury to gymnast Gabriel Langton overshadowed their medal. His horror fall occurred on the opening night of Glasgow 2026.
